INTERNAL_CHAT.TITLE: Internal Chat

AUDIT.ON: Audit on — showing all channels (admin). Click to exit.
AUDIT.READONLY_HINT: Audit mode: read-only (you are not in this conversation).
AUDIT.HINT: Shows every conversation in the account. You can only read the ones you are not in.

INTERNAL_CHAT.EMPTY: No conversations yet. Start one with the + button.
INTERNAL_CHAT.SELECT_PROMPT: Select a conversation to start chatting.
INTERNAL_CHAT.SEND_ERROR: Couldn't send the message. Please try again.
INTERNAL_CHAT.ACTION_ERROR: Couldn't complete that action. Please try again.
INTERNAL_CHAT.NO_TEAMS: You are not part of any team.

NOTIFICATIONS.TITLE: Notifications
NOTIFICATIONS.SUBTITLE: How you're alerted when a teammate messages you.
NOTIFICATIONS.DESKTOP_HINT: System alert even when the tab is in the background.
NOTIFICATIONS.SOUND_HINT: Play a sound on new messages.
NOTIFICATIONS.BLOCKED: Notifications are blocked in your browser. Enable them in the site settings to get desktop alerts.

INTERNAL_CHAT.SEARCH_MIN_HINT: Type at least 2 characters to search.

AUDIO.REQUESTING: Allow the microphone in the browser prompt…
AUDIO.STOP: Stop recording (you can listen before sending)
AUDIO.PERMISSION_DENIED: The browser blocked the microphone. Click the lock next to the site address and allow the microphone.
AUDIO.NO_MIC: No microphone found on this computer.
AUDIO.UNSUPPORTED: This browser can't record audio. Use an up-to-date Chrome, Edge or Firefox.
AUDIO.RECORD_ERROR: Couldn't record the audio. Try again.
AUDIO.SEEK: Move forward or back in the audio

HEADER.DETAILS: See details: participants, photos and files

MUTE.HINT: No sound or alert. Mentions of you still notify.
MUTE.ACTIVE: Muted conversation: no sound or alert

LIST.PICK_MEMBERS: Check who is in the group:
LIST.TEAMS_HINT: One group per team, with every team member. Click to open.
LIST.EMPTY_HINT: Talk to a teammate or your team without leaving the app.
LIST.NO_UNREAD: All caught up. No conversation with new messages.
LIST.NO_FAVORITES: No favorites. Open a conversation and use ⋮ › Add to favorites.

THREAD.EMPTY_HINT: Type below and press Enter. Use @ to call someone and #123 to point to a customer conversation.
THREAD.NO_MATCH: No message with that text in this conversation.

INFO.NO_MEDIA: No photos or files in this conversation yet.

EMPTY_STATE.PICK: Pick a conversation on the side or start a new one.
EMPTY_STATE.FIRST: Talk to teammates and teams without leaving the app. Start your first conversation.
EMPTY_STATE.TIP_MENTION: Use @name to alert someone in a group
EMPTY_STATE.TIP_CONVERSATION: Type #123 to link straight to a customer conversation
EMPTY_STATE.TIP_SHARE: In a customer conversation, ⋮ › Share to internal chat
EMPTY_STATE.PRIVATE: Internal messages: only your team sees them

CLEAR.TITLE: Clear conversation?
CLEAR.BODY: Messages disappear only from your screen until you reload the page. Nothing is deleted for other participants.
